title: Analyst, Infrastructure
description:
GIC is one of the world’s largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 offices around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world’s industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore’s financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.
Infrastructure
We deploy long-term capital through direct, and fund investments across the capital structure to diversify our portfolio. You will help to preserve and enhance the value of our direct private and public equity investments, working with top management teams and board of directors.

The Sao Paulo team was established in 2015, and currently has nine investment professionals. The team is focused on analyzing opportunities in South and Central America, as well as managing the investments made since 2013 in the region. It is integrated into the global team which operates from London, New York, Singapore and Sao Paulo.

Illustrative investments include Aegea (water and sanitation in Brazil), CART/Eixo SP (toll roads in Brazil), V.tal (fiber optics in Brazil), Neoenergia Transmission (power transmission in Brazil), NTS (gas pipeline in Brazil) and Isagen (power generation in Colombia), amongst others. GIC Infrastructure approaches investments with a buy and hold perspective and manages assets with a long-term perspective. We focus on minority / co-control investments alongside industrial and financial partners and have consolidated ourselves as one of the most active investors in the sector and region.

We are looking for a suitable candidate to join our Sao Paulo team as an Analyst. GIC desires to become the leading long term global infrastructure investor and an outstanding career path is available for high performers.
What impact can you make in this role
You will be part of a team that invests into infrastructure companies with stable and predictable cash flows, reasonable risk-adjusted returns and strong impact to local economies.

What you will do as an Analyst
• Play a central role in growing GIC Infrastructure’s portfolio and supporting existing investments in the region.
• Under the supervision of the senior team, play an integral role in the full deal lifecycle: deal screening, approvals, execution, asset management and, when appropriate, exits.
• Take on primary role in the financial modeling of transactions, deal with senior management, external advisors and banks.
• Play a key part in deal screening and appraisal, contributing to transaction analysis, and helping prepare the documentation to support investment decisions to investment committee.
• Investment focus is likely to be biased towards, but not limited to, the power, midstream, transportation, digital infrastructure and water utility sectors. No experience in infrastructure sectors is required, but the candidate will be required to conduct financial research on public and private companies for potential acquisitions.
• The team operates in a flat and meritocratic culture, empowering staff with open communications and robust challenges. Being a team player and interacting with counterparties in a way that builds on our reputation is everyone’s responsibility.
What makes you a successful candidate?
• Bachelor’s degree from a top-tier university with coursework emphasizing business administration, economics, accounting, finance, and/or engineering. Graduation date between June 2024 and June 2025.
• Previous experience working for a private equity fund, institutional investors, or for investment banks as part of the M&A advisory or Equity research team. Experience in the infrastructure sector is not required.
• Outstanding financial modelling skills are assumed and will be tested. The ability to build models from scratch is required, as well as model review and scenario development.
• You will be detail-oriented with a hands-on attitude to deal execution and will thrive in a culture of high-expectations and personal responsibility to own the investment.
• Strong commercial and intellectual curiosity is a requirement to perform well and advance.
Work at the Point of Impact
We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-Term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.
Flexibility at GIC
At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office at least four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.

We are an equal opportunity employer
As an employer, we passionately believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of GIC teams to drive competitive performance. An inclusive environment yields exceptional contribution.

title: Engineering Manager, MAAS
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager, MAAS role at Canonical

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager, MAAS role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team. Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We're hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.
MAAS components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.
At Canonical you must have a solid technical background, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.
The successful candidate will have leadership attributes, deep knowledge of Linux, and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.
Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.
The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of engineers in your time zone (we organise engineering teams by Americas, EMEA etc)
  • Talent development through coaching, mentoring, feedback and career planning
  • Setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Being an advocate of, and advancing, modern software development practices
  • Participating in the engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Engaging with broader teams at Canonical, the open source community and partners
  • Travelling to internal and external global events for 4 to 6 weeks per year
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • You understand modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8s
  • You have experience programming in Python and Go
  • You love developing and growing people and have a strong track record of doing it
Nice-to-have skills
  • Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

O prazo para envio de currículos é até 03 de março.

Descrição do Cargo e Responsabilidades

Procuramos uma pessoa com experiência em gestão financeira e administrativa em instituições sem fins lucrativos, que tenha excelente capacidade técnica e operacional, com habilidade de comunicação oral/escrita e visão estratégica, para observar e colaborar na construção das normas internas da Fundação NHR Brasil, tanto financeiras como administrativas.

O cargo terá as seguintes atribuições, dentre outras:

  • Planejar, coordenar e gerenciar atividades administrativas, financeiras e relacionadas a RH, assegurando a conformidade com as diretrizes, políticas e procedimentos da organização.
  • Apoiar e fornecer insumos e orientações sobre o planejamento administrativo e financeiro da organização e dos seus projetos, monitoramento e processos de avaliação, incluindo o desenvolvimento e monitoramento do orçamento.
  • Preparar relatórios financeiros precisos e oportunos dos projetos e das atividades organizacionais de acordo com as exigências internas e externas da organização e dos seus financiadores.
  • Contribuir no planejamento e elaboração dos orçamentos dos projetos da Fundação.
  • Acompanhar a execução do orçamento anual da Fundação NHR Brasil.
  • Preparar e acompanhar a execução do orçamento e dos relatórios financeiros para a financiadora internacional, NLR.
  • Coordenar com a equipe as ações relacionadas aos contratos, orçamentos e relatórios financeiros de acordo com a demanda.
  • Manter o relacionamento e prestar apoio para a boa condução dos trabalhos realizados pela contabilidade e pela auditoria da Fundação NHR Brasil.
  • Realizar a gestão do sistema financeiro e de projetos da Fundação (atualmente o Auditus).
  • Fazer o acompanhamento e dar suporte ao trabalho da empresa contratada como BPO Financeira da Fundação NHR Brasil.
  • Fazer a gestão dos contratos da Fundação NHR Brasil e o relacionamento com os fornecedores.
  • Realizar as compras da instituição.
  • Manter o controle do patrimônio da Fundação NHR Brasil.
  • Fazer a gestão da folha salarial e pagamento de demais prestadores de serviços da organização.
  • Realizar o recrutamento de pessoal, treinamento, gerenciamento de desempenho, remuneração e programas de benefícios.

Captação de Recursos

  • Acompanhar as doações dos contribuintes recorrentes da Fundação NHR Brasil.
  • Preparar relatórios de receitas das doações para a Diretora Executiva e o Conselho Curador da instituição.
  • Apoiar o trabalho da direção executiva na captação de recursos e negociações com plataformas.
  • Elaborar orçamentos para projetos de captação, junto com a equipe programática.

Perfil e Qualificações Mínimas

REQUERIDO: Graduação em nível superior, em curso na área de ciências sociais aplicadas, como administração, contabilidade, economia, etc.

QUALIFICAÇÕES MÍNIMAS: Experiência profissional mínima de 5 anos em administração e finanças de organizações sem fins lucrativos. Domínio de ferramentas de gestão e fluência em inglês.

DIFERENCIAIS DO (A) CANDIDATO (A): Experiência prévia em organizações da área da saúde, pesquisa e/ou em organizações da cooperação internacional. Pós-graduação em gestão de organizações sem fins lucrativos. Bom domínio de inglês.

Informações sobre a vaga

  • Local de trabalho: Aldeota, Fortaleza, Ceará
  • Carga horária: 40 horas semanais
  • Salário: 9.500 reais mensais brutos, CLT
  • Demanda de viagem: eventual, previamente acordada
  • Candidatos que forem (as) aprovados (as) para a entrevista, após a análise curricular, serão contactados até dia 06/03
  • Entrevistas em português e inglês, via Zoom, datas e horários a serem agendados e serão informados com brevidade aos candidatos selecionados na avaliação curricular.
  • O resultado final será divulgado na página da NHR Brasil com data a ser definida após o final das entrevistas.

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária
A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom
O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

We are FIS. Our technology powers the world’s economy and our teams bring innovation to life. We champion diversity to deliver the best products and solutions for our colleagues, clients and communities. If you’re ready to start learning, growing and making an impact with a career in fintech, we’d like to know: Are you FIS?

About the role:
As a Sales Executive Senior, you’ll be part of a team of self-motivated, high achieving sales professionals helping small, medium and large sized business owners grow their businesses. By providing industry-leading solutions, you’ll drive some of the most exciting new technology in fintech while advancing the way the world pays, banks and invests.
What you will do:

  • Prospect and target new customers based in Brazil, operating in the financial services, payments, banking, and retail industries.

  • Work with branch managers and staff of assigned banks or partners to build relationships and educate small to large sized business owners about FIS products and services.

  • Identify new prospects and revenue opportunities, building new relationships from scratch and using a portfolio of target clients.

  • Retain and manage existing customers, focusing on overall customer success and satisfaction.

  • Deliver value and be a strong negotiator.

  • Leverage referred leads and self-cultivated leads to nurture your pipeline.

  • Connect with prospects to help improve their experience, cash flow, and bottom line.

  • Collaborate with sales teams and focus on growing the existing customer base.

  • Prepares and present proposals to clients. Negotiates, structures and closes “deals” that meet customer and FIS’s expectations.

  • Track sales activity and maintain accurate records using CRM software. Maintain pipeline accuracy and sales forecast, as well as close plans, account and territory plans.

  • Stay updated on industry trends, market conditions, and competitor activities.

  • Collaborate closely with internal teams including product, marketing, and operations to ensure seamless execution of campaigns.

  • Ability to work with an interdisciplinary team within FIS with leadership and make things happen

What you will need:

  • Fluency in Portuguese and English, both verbal and written.

  • 8+ years of sales experience including research, discovering needs, recommending solutions, solving business problem, and customer retention (experience in both hunter and farmer positions).

  • Knowledge of Brazil’s payments ecosystem, banking ecosystem, and financial solutions.

  • Proven track record of new business solution selling, ideally within financial services, payments, banking, or similar industries such as financial software solutions or technology.

  • A consultative approach and proven success identifying, influencing and presenting to C-suite and key decision makers.

  • Expert negotiation and communication skills (concise and direct).

  • Confidence working in an autonomous environment where change is frequent.

  • Disciplined and collaborative work ethic.


Added bonus if you have:

  • Experience using a CRM such as Microsoft Dynamics.

  • Residence in São Paulo City to facilitate easy access to in-person meetings with prospective and current customers, as well as FIS leadership and teammates.


What we offer you:
At FIS, we are as committed to growing our employees’ careers as our own business.We offer:

  • Opportunities to innovate in fintech

  • Inclusive and diverse team atmosphere

  • Professional and personal development

  • Resources to contribute to your community

  • Competitive salary and benefits

Privacy Statement

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice .

Sourcing Model

Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

Como Technical Account Manager (TAM), você será a ponte entre nossos clientes e a equipe técnica, garantindo a integração dos dados tanto de entrada quanto de saída.   6. Trabalhar na melhoria contínua dos processos de integração e suporte técnico aos clientes.
  7. Criar e manter as documentações funcionais e técnicas atualizadas no que tange aos processos internos e externos de integração.

Esse é um desafio para quem tem:

  1. SQL intermediário: Capacidade de escrever, revisar e otimizar queries para extração e transformação de dados.
  2. Conhecimento em APIs e automação (desejável): Experiência com consumo de APIs RESTful e scripts para automação de tarefas técnicas.
  3. Boa comunicação: Facilidade para interagir com clientes técnicos e não técnicos, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas.
  4. Capacidade analítica: Habilidade para identificar e solucionar problemas de inconsistência ou divergência de dados.
  5. Organização e gestão de tarefas: Capacidade de priorizar demandas e gerenciar múltiplos clientes simultaneamente.
  6. Agilidade e poder de persuasão: Capacidade de negociar com os clientes e stakeholders, em defesa das necessidades e desejos dos clientes sem esquecer das necessidades da empresa.

Será legal se você tiver:

  1. Conhecimento no segmento de Varejo.
  2. Ter trabalhado com ERPs.
  3. Experiência com integrações de dados: Conhecimento sobre bancos de dados relacionais e processos ETL.
  4. Conhecimento em ferramentas no code como Zapier, n8n.
  5. Conhecimento em ferramentas de dataviz como Metabase.

title: Manager, Capacity Planning & Network Modeling
description:
Manager, Capacity Planning & Network Modeling

Empresa: Ball Corporation

Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminum packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe!

Ball is thrilled to receive Newsweek's 2023 Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplace award! As a sustainable product leader, we have over 16,000 global team members. From endlessly recyclable aluminum cans, and cups, to aerosol bottles, our goal is to contribute to a better community, society, and world.

Position Overview:
Optimize global logistics network efficiency and effectiveness through capacity planning, network modeling, and warehouse engineering. This role analyzes infrastructure, mid- and long-term supply plans, and designs agile, cost-effective networks to accommodate growth while maximizing service levels.

Your Key Responsibilities Include:

  1. Conduct detailed analysis of current logistics capacity, including warehouse space, transportation routes, and distribution centers, to identify optimization opportunities. Project mid- and long-term capacity requirements. Monitor KPIs related to logistics capacity and network performance.
  2. Utilize advanced modeling techniques and simulation tools to translate supply plans into optimal logistics networks, considering transportation costs, lead times, inventory levels, and service requirements. Provide short-term analysis and recommendations for resilient network adaptations in response to unplanned capacity or demand changes.
  3. Design and oversee warehouse layout plans to maximize productivity and throughput volumes.
  4. Establish and maintain global MHE (Material Handling Equipment), including automation standards and requirements.
  5. Collaborate with cross-functional teams—commercial, operations, planning, logistics, and finance—to align capacity planning efforts with business objectives.
  6. Lead projects and coordinate stakeholder resources for capacity expansion initiatives, such as warehouse expansions, fleet upgrades, or network reconfigurations.
  7. Regularly review and audit logistics capacity and network performance to ensure alignment with business needs.
  8. Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in logistics capacity planning, network modeling, and warehouse design.
  9. Provide guidance and support to logistics team members on capacity planning tools, processes, and methodologies.

Required Experience and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Supply Chain Management, Statistics, or equivalent experience.
  • Fluent or advanced proficiency in English.
  • Logistics Experience:
    • Experience in logistics operations, including transportation, warehousing, and distribution, with a focus on network optimization strategies.
    • Experience designing and optimizing logistics networks, considering costs, lead times, and service levels.
  • Capacity Planning:
    • Experience in demand forecasting and resource optimization within logistics.
    • Ability to analyze logistics capacity data and identify areas for improvement.
    • Proficiency with modeling and simulation tools for demand forecasting and capacity evaluation.
  • Network Modeling:
    • Experience in designing agile, cost-effective logistics networks using various modeling tools and techniques.
  • Team Collaboration and Interpersonal Skills:
    • Ability to effectively collaborate across departments to align capacity planning with business goals.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ethnicity, genetic information, ancestry, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, age, political affiliation, or other non-merit factors.

When you join Ball, you become part of a team of over 16,000 members worldwide. Our products, from recyclable cans and cups to aerosol bottles, help our customers contribute to a better world.

We are committed to diversity and inclusion, fostering a culture of belonging.

Everyone at Ball makes a difference through the work they love. Our creations may change, but our impact remains constant.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our client is a digital-first creative agency that blends technology and creativity to tackle the biggest challenges facing today's brands. They take an outcome-driven, user-centric approach, ensuring that every solution they deliver is both effective and engaging. They are trusted by some of the world's most ambitious brands, including Apple, Nike, T-Mobile, and The Trevor Project, demonstrating their ability to deliver exceptional results for a diverse range of clients.

  • Professional digital design experience, bonus if it’s with a marketing agency.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

Somos um time de pessoas experientes em estruturação de negócios de zero a um, especialistas no mercado de energia e mercado financeiro, especialistas em produtos digitais e regulatórios. Somos abertos para co-criar soluções com os participantes do mercado. Aqui, as pessoas têm um papel-chave na construção de uma startup com acionistas sólidos e que vai moldar e elevar a potência do mercado de energia no Brasil. Pessoas que gostam de autonomia, de trabalhar em equipe, que buscam aprendizado constante e entregas com excelência florescem no ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, com uma hierarquia horizontal, diversidade e muita mão na massa.

A N5X está procurando um(a) Especialista de Backoffice de Comercialização de Energia Elétrica para contribuir para o desenvolvimento das políticas e processos de pós-negociação de contratos bilaterais de compra e venda de energia elétrica e de contratos futuros de energia da nova bolsa de energia do Brasil, alavancando o capital intelectual dos acionistas (Nodal Exchange, EEX e B3, através da L4).


ESCOPO

  1. Definição de políticas e processos de pós-negociação bilaterais e/ou multilateral e centralizado de contratos futuros de energia, incluindo as rotinas da CCEE tais quais: CliqCCEE, registros, ajustes e validação de contratos, sazonalização de contratos, alterações cadastrais, relatórios CCEE;
  2. Elaboração de Políticas e Manuais de pós-negociação;
  3. Especificação e implementação de processos, controles e sistemas de pós negociação;
  4. Interface com times internos (regulatório e jurídico, risco, produto, tecnologia e projetos) como business owner das políticas e processos de negociação;
  5. Interface com externos na implementação das políticas e processos de pós-negociação.

HABILIDADES

  1. Organização: capacidade para gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e prioridades de forma eficaz.
  2. Comunicação: excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita para interagir e construir relacionamento com diversos stakeholders.
  3. Resolução de problemas: forte capacidade de estruturação do problema, análise e recomendação.

description:
Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer

Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer role at Canonical

Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer to our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is an opportunity for an "automation-first" senior technologist with a passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have experience of IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
Job Summary
The IS team at Canonical supports and maintains all of Canonical's IT production services. The team is in charge of running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users.
As an Senior SRE & Gitops engineer you'll be in a unique position to drive operations automation to the next level, both in our own private clouds as well as in the public clouds. We do this by utilizing the best of open source infrastructure as code software, software development practices such as CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical's leading products for software operation automation.
In addition to defining the infrastructure as code, you will improve Canonical products and the open-source technologies they're based on by providing critical feedback to developers on how their products operate at scale. This is done by submitting bugs (and sometimes writing pull requests) and collaborating on design and implementations with other teams within the company.
You'll be part of a global team of SREs that work together and support each other to provide the best possible services to our company, Canonical's customers and the Ubuntu Community.
As a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer you will

  • Drive the development of automation, Gitops in your team as an embedded tech lead
  • Closely collaborate with the IS architect to align your solutions with the IS architecture vision
  • Design and architect services that IS can offer to the organization as products
  • Apply your experience of IaC to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS by constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processes
  • Automate software operations for re-usability and consistency across private and public clouds, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systems
  • Maintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical's core services, networks, and infrastructure
  • Develop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation, Setting up, maintaining and using observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design, implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for various systems and services
  • Provide assistance and work with globally distributed engineering, operations, and support peers
  • Be given uninterrupted development time to focus on larger projects and automation of manual tasks
  • Share your experience, know-how and best practices with other team members in design sessions, mentorship and 'doing work together'
  • Carry final responsibility for time-critical escalations
What we are looking for in you
  • A modern view on hosting architecture, driven by infrastructure as code across both private and public clouds.
  • A product mindset thriving to develop products rather than solutions.
  • Python software development experience, with large projects
  • Experience working with Kubernetes or other container orchestration systems.
  • Proven exposure to manage and deploy cloud infrastructure with code.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls
  • Affinity with various forms of Linux storage, from Ceph to Databases
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise Linux servers
  • Extensive knowledge of cloud computing concepts and technologies
  • Bachelor's degree or greater, preferably in computer science or related engineering field
  • Able to communicate clearly and effectively in English over email, chat, video or voice calls and in-person
  • Motivated and able to troubleshoot from kernel to web, and willing to ask others when appropriate
  • A willingness to be flexible and able to learn new things quickly
  • Be inspired by the needs of fast-changing environments
  • Happy to work within distributed teams
  • Be passionate and familiarized about open-source, especially Ubuntu or Debian
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Software Engineer - Python - Ubuntu Pro client - graduate level
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Software Engineer - Python - Ubuntu Pro client - graduate level role at Canonical

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Engineer - Python - Ubuntu Pro client - graduate level role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include top public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders across sectors. We are a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and few office-based roles. Teams meet 2-4 times yearly in interesting locations worldwide to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Software Engineer to develop, test, and release improvements to the Ubuntu Pro client.

Ubuntu Pro is a suite of services for enterprise and personal users, managed via a command-line tool that handles security patching and more.

You will work with the Ubuntu Server team, cloud partners, and other Canonical teams to improve the Pro client, ensuring its quality and stability, which is critical as it is pre-installed on every Ubuntu system. You will also communicate with users to meet their needs.

This role requires quality-focused software engineering in Python, with an emphasis on interoperability across various environments. Strong Python skills are essential, and contributions to open source projects are advantageous. Knowledge of apt, deb packaging, and system administration is beneficial.

Applicants should be passionate about Ubuntu, quality, and building tools used globally. They should consider edge cases, usability, documentation, and community coordination, working with a broad spectrum of end users.

The role entails:

  • Proactive collaboration with a distributed team
  • Writing high-quality code with tests to develop new features
  • Debugging and fixing issues
  • Code reviews
  • Discussing ideas and investigating solutions
  • Remote work with occasional travel (2-4 weeks/year)

What we are looking for in you:

  • Passion for technology and collaboration with talented people
  • Curiosity, flexibility, articulation, accountability
  • Valuing soft skills, being passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, self-motivated
  • Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM, or related field
  • Extensive experience with Python on Linux
  • Interest/experience in Ubuntu Linux administration, CI, Debian packaging, cloud environments
  • Bonus: open source community engagement experience

What we offer colleagues:
We offer competitive worldwide compensation, annual reviews, and benefits aligned with our values, including:

  • Distributed work environment with biannual in-person sprints
  • USD 2,000 annual learning budget
  • Recognition rewards, holiday leave, parental leave
  • Wellness programs, travel opportunities, travel perks

About Canonical:
Canonical leads in open source innovation, publishing Ubuntu, a key platform for AI, IoT, and cloud. We hire globally, uphold high standards, and promote excellence. Most colleagues work remotely, and working here encourages innovative thinking, skill development, and personal growth.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer:
We foster a discrimination-free workplace. Diversity enhances our environment and products, and all applications are given fair consideration.

Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde – para cuidar de você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos) oferecemos o plano nacional, sem mensalidade;
  • Plano Odontológico – para sempre ver você sorrindo, oferecemos o plano odontológico, sem mensalidade para você e extensivo aos seus dependentes;

  • Seguro de Vida – além dos serviços que já conhecemos, inclui cesta natalidade e pode ser acionado em casos de Auxílio Funeral, é aquela ajuda na hora que mais precisamos;
  • Auxílio Graduação ou Pós-Graduação – o Sicredi acredita e investe no seu desenvolvimento;
  • PPR (Programa de Participação nos Resultados) e Gratificação Semestral – conquistamos juntos e celebramos juntos as nossas conquistas e resultados;
  • Auxílio Creche - o Sicredi cuida também do bem-estar do seu filho, seja através de babá, creche ou escola;

  • Auxílio Certificação ANBIMA – oferecemos para você o auxílio da certificação ANBIMA na adesão e/ou renovação para que você possa se desenvolver ainda mais;
  • Sempre Bem – para você e seus dependentes, oferecemos assistência psicológica, orientação jurídica, consultoria financeira, apoio emocional à gestante e serviço social;
  • Licença Luto - em caso de morte de pais, filhos, irmãos ou cônjuge são concedidos mais 3 dias úteis de licença, além dos 2 dias previstos em lei;
  • Férias – o Sicredi disponibiliza a possibilidade de férias em até 2 períodos para você aproveitar da melhor forma;
  • Reconhecimento por anos de Sicredi – reconhecemos você através dos anos de empresa com uma lembrança;
  • Educação Financeira – você tem acesso ao seu Gerente de Agência para consultas financeiras sempre que precisar, além de crédito consignado e cheque especial com taxas diferenciadas;
  • Day off de Aniversário - para aproveitar o dia do seu jeito, é um benefício concedido no dia do aniversário;
  • Gympass - acesso a academias, aulas de Yoga, Meditação e Funcional, um benefício completo para você e extensivo aos dependentes;

  • Desconto Farmácia – oferecemos desconto nas farmácias para que quando precisar comprar medicamentos, obtenha essa facilidade;
  • Telemedicina – o Sicredi oferece para você consultas com diversas especialidades de forma on-line;
  • Vacinação anual contra a gripe H1N1 – para garantir ainda mais cuidado com você, oferecemos anualmente a vacinação contra a gripe;
  • Previdência Privada - para garantir um futuro próspero, o Sicredi contribui com a sua previdência com igual valor da sua contribuição.

Sobre o Sicredi

Somos o Sicredi, a primeira Instituição Financeira Cooperativa do Brasil. Há mais de 120 anos, nos reinventamos a cada dia e nos desafiamos em tudo o que fazemos, sendo impulsionados pelo trabalho de cada uma das nossas pessoas colaboradoras.

Nosso propósito é construir uma sociedade mais próspera ao lado dos mais de 45 mil talentos que também acreditam nessa transformação. Evoluímos constantemente e mantemos a essência do cooperativismo para superar as barreiras, conquistar novos horizontes e desenvolver a sociedade com maior inclusão, diversidade e equidade.

Não é à toa que somos a Melhor Empresa para se Trabalhar no Brasil 2024 , segundo a GPTW!

description:
Advogado Junior de Contencioso Judicial Tributário - DF

Job Description
Mattos Filho é reconhecido no mercado brasileiro como o escritório líder na prática Tributária. Nossa área é organizada em núcleos especializados em diferentes áreas do direito tributário, que prestam serviços legais no contencioso, na esfera administrativa e judicial, consultorias em geral, suporte às operações de M&A, operações financeiras, entre outros. Isso permite que tenhamos uma equipe completamente qualificada para atender a toda e qualquer solicitação dos clientes, independentemente da demanda.

Contencioso Judicial

  • Maior equipe especializada em contencioso judicial entre os grandes escritórios;
  • Rede de correspondentes em praticamente todos os estados do Brasil;
  • Presença relevante em Brasília – acompanhamento dos principais leading cases no Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) e Superior Tribunal de Justiça (STJ).

Responsibilities and Assignments

  • Elaboração de pareceres e opiniões legais sobre temas vinculados à estratégia processual;
  • Atuação no questionamento judicial de tributos cobrados ilegalmente nas esferas municipal, estadual, federal, em todas as etapas dos processos;
  • Apoio na elaboração de defesas em execuções fiscais, igualmente envolvendo os mais variados tributos;
  • Propositura de ações judiciais para discussão dos mais variados tributos federais, estaduais e municipais;
  • Acompanhamento dos principais leading cases no STF (Supremo Tribunal Federal) e STJ (Superior Tribunal de Justiça);
  • Participação direta em muitos processos relevantes na qualidade de amicus curiae, para atuação institucional.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Superior Completo em Direito;
  • Inscrição na OAB;
  • Pós-graduação e/ou especialização em áreas correlatas;
  • Desejável experiência em escritório;
  • Inglês Avançado é imprescindível.

Benefícios

  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Participação nos Resultados;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Gympass.

Sobre Nós

O Mattos Filho é um escritório de alta performance, líder nas suas áreas de atuação, oferecendo trabalho de excelência e inovador para seus clientes em mais de 40 áreas do Direito. Com estrutura full-service, estamos presentes em locais estratégicos e temos grupos de trabalho regionais, que garantem a proximidade com clientes e parceiros no Brasil e em diversos países, impulsionando a geração de negócios e a tomada de decisões importantes.

Somos reconhecidos no mercado pela excelência e eficiência do nosso atendimento. No Chambers Brazil Awards, somos recordistas na categoria Brazil Law Firm of the Year , tendo sido eleitos por sete vezes como o escritório do ano no país. Resultados como esse são possíveis pois valorizamos e impulsionamos talentos, desenvolvendo competências e criando oportunidades que impactem positivamente a carreira de nossos profissionais.

Nosso pioneirismo também se reflete em ações que evidenciam o papel social da advocacia, como a nossa atuação pro bono e as iniciativas voltadas à promoção da diversidade, equidade e inclusão, que buscam contribuir para a promoção do Direito e a construção de uma sociedade mais justa e igualitária.

Company Description

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.

As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!

Your Career

As a Domain Consultant for network security transformation, you provide technical expertise and guidance in customers' network security and zero trust journey. You will be key in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives. You evangelize our industry leadership in on-prem, cloud, and security services that establish Palo Alto Networks as a customer’s cybersecurity partner.

Your Impact

  • Collaborate with sales teams to recommend and develop customer solutions within your assigned specialization
  • Present to customers as our expert at all levels in the customer hierarchy, from practitioner to senior leadership
  • Lead and support customer demonstrations that showcase our unique value proposition
  • Responsible for prospective customers and partners' Technical Validation projects based on best practices to ensure technical win in assigned opportunities
  • Architect solutions that will help our customers strengthen and simplify their security posture
  • Document high-level design and key use cases to ensure proper implementation and value realization of Palo Alto Networks solutions
  • Lead conversations about industry trends and emerging changes to the security landscape
  • Responsible for discussing and highlighting product alignment with customer requirements and differentiation
  • As the main technical point of contact for Network Security, you will assist and collaborate to respond effectively to RFIs/RFPs
  • Position Palo Alto Networks or Partner delivered services as appropriate to ensure proper implementation and value realization of Palo Alto Networks solutions
  • Discuss, with credibility, competitive offers in the marketplace and position ours as the best alternative

Your Experience

  • 3+ years experience in pre-sales/sales engineering within Zero Trust, Networking, Network Security, SaaS Security or SSE/SASE
  • Outstanding customer communication and problem-solving skills
  • Experience in working with customers, demonstrating problem-solving skills and a can-do attitude
  • Solid understanding of NGFW, Network Security, SASE, SD-WAN, CASB, Proxy, DLP and BYOD Solutions
  • Advanced knowledge of On-Premise and Cloud-Delivered Network Security Technologies
  • Fluent Portuguese & proficient English language skills

The Team

Our team members work hand-in-hand with large organizations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients in their journey to transform their security architectures.

You are empowered with unmatched systems and tools and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. Our Solutions Consulting community is driven by the mission to be our customers’ cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting their digital way of life.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Engenheira de Machine Learning para integrar a nossa equipe no Data Platform & MLOps. Nossa missão é desenvolver ferramentas e processos que impulsionem a inovação e otimizem a operação de projetos de Machine Learning em toda a empresa. A squad de MLE desempenha um papel central na construção da plataforma MLOPs, focando na criação de novas funcionalidades que abrangem todo o ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento e entrega de modelos, desde a coleta de dados até o deployment em produção. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de causar impacto direto em diferentes áreas da companhia, trabalhando com tecnologia de ponta e frameworks modernos. Oferecemos um ambiente colaborativo e dinâmico, onde você terá liberdade para explorar e inovar, com o suporte de uma equipe altamente qualificada e aberta a novas ideias.

  • Colaborar com uma equipe multidisciplinar e ágil de Machine Learning Engineers, Data Engineers e Site Reliability Engineers para arquitetar e implementar soluções de ML, sejam ferramentas, serviços ou contribuindo para nossa plataforma de ML e Data;
  • Desenvolver ferramentas que auxiliem nossos Data Scientists em suas funções diárias;
  • Desenvolver arquiteturas robustas e escaláveis sempre tendo em foco os conceitos de MLOps.

  • Experiência prévia atuando com Engenharia de Machine Learning;
  • Conhecimento em Git;
  • Experiência com cloud (AWS);
  • Experiência com CI/CD (Jenkins, ArgoCD, Harness);

  • Conhecimentos básicos de Engenharia de Software;
  • Conhecimento sobre fundamentos de ML: Não apenas sobre algoritmos, mas como funcionam;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Python;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas para manipulação de dados (spark, pandas, numpy);
  • Conhecimento básico de tecnologias para conteinerização (Docker, Podman);
  • Conhecimento com bibliotecas de ML (scikit-learn, tensorflow, pytorch);
  • Conhecimento dos conceitos da cultura MLOps e sua importância;
  • Curiosidade, adaptabilidade, colaboração, ownership e comunicação.

Desejável:

  • Experiência com Kubernetes;
  • Conhecimentos de ferramentas de workflow de projetos de ML (DVC, mlflow).

Additional Information

Na Serasa Experian, acreditamos que a diversidade é fundamental para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e inovador, onde todas as pessoas possam trocar experiências e expressar suas ideias. Join to apply for the Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. If you have experience in IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code, and a passion for technology, you'll thrive here.

Job Summary

The IS team supports and maintains all of Canonical's IT production services, serving over 60 million Ubuntu users. As a Senior SRE & Gitops Engineer, you'll drive operations automation in our private and public clouds using open source infrastructure as code tools, CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical's automation products. You will also provide feedback to developers to improve product operation at scale, contribute to open source projects, and collaborate across teams.

Responsibilities

  • Lead automation and Gitops initiatives as a technical lead within your team.
  • Align solutions with the IS architecture vision by collaborating with the IS architect.
  • Design and develop services to be offered as products by IS.
  • Advance infrastructure as code practices, increasing automation and process improvements.
  • Automate software operations across clouds, considering distributed system complexities.
  • Maintain operational responsibility for core services, networks, and infrastructure.
  • Enhance troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance monitoring using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch.
  • Support and collaborate with global engineering, operations, and support teams.
  • Focus on larger projects and automation during dedicated development time.
  • Share expertise through design sessions, mentorship, and collaborative work.
  • Handle time-critical escalations responsibly.

Qualifications

  • Experience with hosting architecture driven by infrastructure as code across private and public clouds.
  • Product mindset focused on developing products rather than just solutions.
  • Proficiency in Python, especially with large projects.
  • Experience with Kubernetes or similar container orchestration systems.
  • Proven ability to manage and deploy cloud infrastructure with code.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls.
  • Familiarity with Linux storage solutions like Ceph and databases.
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise Linux servers.
  • Deep understanding of cloud computing concepts and technologies.
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or related field.
  • Effective communication skills in English via multiple channels.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills from kernel to web, with a collaborative attitude.
  • Willingness to learn quickly and adapt to fast-changing environments.
  • Comfort working within distributed teams.
  • Passion for open source, especially Ubuntu or Debian.

What We Offer

Competitive global compensation, annual reviews, performance bonuses, and benefits aligned with our values. Additional perks include:

  • Distributed work environment with biannual in-person team sprints.
  • USD 2,000 annual learning and development budget.
  • Recognition rewards, annual leave, parental leave, wellness programs, and travel opportunities.

About Canonical

Canonical pioneers open source, publishing Ubuntu, a key platform for AI, IoT, and cloud. We hire globally, uphold high standards, and foster a discrimination-free workplace. Working here challenges you to think differently, learn continually, and excel.

Para chegar lá, investimos acima de tudo nas nossas pessoas, que formam um time incrível e comprometido com esse grande objetivo. E aí, vem com a gente?

Nossa cultura

Nossos valores são a base para tudo que fazemos! Aqui na Unico, agimos sem fronteiras; impactamos sem rodeios; somos transparentes mesmo em situações difíceis; resilientes e adaptáveis para evoluir; fazemos a coisa certa do jeito certo e somos ousados ao liderar a construção do futuro. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é descontraído e colaborativo, cheio de oportunidades de aprendizado e possibilidades para você desenvolver sua carreira com autonomia e apoio de líderes e colegas.

Junto com o time contábil criar controles e alinhar processos com demais áreas de forma que tenhamos confiabilidade em nossos números.

O que você fará/será responsável por:

  • Rotina de fechamento contábil, incluindo interação com demais áreas;
  • Analisar e conciliar as contábeis patrimoniais e de resultado, garantindo a veracidade das informações, com relatórios suporte e plano de correção;
  • Suporte para atendimento a auditoria externa (Big Four);
  • Atuar em reuniões de alinhamento e processos de melhoria contínua;
  • Garantir e cumprir a legislação e práticas contábeis de fechamento mensal e anual, com informações para as Demonstrações Financeiras.

Conhecimento e Experiências:

  • Formação em Ciências Contábeis;
  • Experiência de 5 a 10 anos na área contábil ou correlatas;
  • Conhecimento contábil dos seguintes temas: conciliação bancária, folha de pagamento, provisões e estimativas contábeis, consolidação, PCLD, receita e breakage (IFRS 15) e revisão analítica;
  • Interação e revisão de contabilidades externas, a fim de garantir o cumprimento dos prazos (administrar eventos não esperados e analisar impactos previamente);
  • Experiência com elaboração de demonstrações financeiras em IFRS em sua totalidade (peças contábeis e notas explicativas);
  • Bons conhecimentos fiscais (impostos diretos e indiretos).

  • Ser usuário SAP 4/Hanna;
  • Inglês e espanhol Intermediário;
  • Conhecimentos de ECD e ECF.

R$ 1.500 ,00 por mês que podem ser distribuídos nas modalidades VA/VR, Cultura, Mobilidade e Flex Férias;

valor mensal de R$ 120,00 para pagamento de contas e consumo;

a Unico financia 100% dos estudos para 100% dos colaboradores através de cursos disponíveis na plataforma Unico Skill. Você pode escolher entre graduação, pós-graduação, MBAs, idiomas, cursos especializantes e mentorias;

acesso à plataformas como Gympass e Totalpass;

180 dias para gestantes e cuidadores principais do processo de adoção e 60 dias para não gestantes e cuidados secundários do processo de adoção, com salário e benefícios pagos integralmente ao longo de todo o período.

Local de trabalho

Adotamos o modelo de trabalho que prioriza a conexão e engajamento entre os Seres, o nosso #conectaunico, modelo de trabalho híbrido (2x por semana presencial).

E mais…

Oferecemos um plano de carreira estruturado de acordo com suas competências e interesses, com oportunidade de crescimento como especialista ou líder, incentivando o seu desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional através de ciclos de avaliação de performance semestrais (com feedback estruturado e plano de desenvolvimento individual);

Para completar a sua experiência, por aqui temos palestras, meetups, workshops, treinamentos, day off no aniversário, reunioff às quartas-feiras, festas e celebrações internas/externas, happy hour presencial quinzenal, grupos de afinidade e ginástica laboral.

Diversidade & Inclusão

Na Unico estamos empenhados em construir uma cultura inclusiva, valorizando em todas as nossas posições a candidatura de todas as pessoas, independentemente de sua etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, política, religião, deficiência, naturalidade ou qualquer outro tipo de característica.

Te convidamos a respondê-lo pra nos ajudar nesse processo, mas deixamos claro que você pode optar por não fazer isso sem impacto na sua avaliação. description:
Gerenciar os projetos de Design de Serviço ou Design de Produto, do planejamento do cronograma à gestão de riscos e stakeholders;

Garantir que as entregas do projeto enderecem os objetivos de negócio dos clientes;

Garantir a qualidade da documentação dos projetos;

Facilitar momentos de tomada de decisão dos clientes com base em evidências;

Colocar a mão na massa junto aos times na execução de pesquisas, tanto qualitativas quanto quantitativas;

Facilitar workshops remotos e presenciais para concepção de serviços e produtos;

Desenhar e embasar serviços, produtos e modelos de negócio pela abordagem de design;

Testar hipóteses de serviços e produtos;

Apoiar os times na construção de protótipos e outros artefatos, como jornadas e personas;

Construir apresentações que sintetizem os resultados e decisões de projeto.

Conhecimento teórico e prático em abordagens, técnicas e ferramentas de Design Research, Service Design e Product Design;

Experiência em gestão de projetos, tanto no formato tradicional quanto ágil;

Desejável experiência em gestão de projetos no contexto de consultoria;

Vivência sólida na execução de pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas, com experiência em condução de entrevistas de profundidade, observação de campo, desk research, benchmarking, estudo de tendências, aplicação de formulários, e experimentação baseada em hipóteses;

Experiência com construção e facilitação de workshops para concepção de produtos e serviços;

Conhecimento em estratégia e modelos de negócio, sejam tradicionais ou digitais (cadeia de valor, proposta de valor, processos, metas, métricas, canais de relacionamento, etc);

Conhecimento em produto digital, suas principais métricas, ciclo de desenvolvimento e pesquisa e experimentação aplicada a produto;

Conhecimento na abordagem de OKRs;

Experiência com ferramentas de modelagem de serviços e negócios, como blueprint, jornadas, lean canvas, business model canvas, value proposition canvas, entre outros;

Conhecimento teórico e prático de abordagens de prototipagem e teste de serviços, produtos e modelos de negócio;

Forte orientação a resultados, sabendo conectar pesquisa e design a impacto em alavancas de negócio;

CLT 44 horas semanais;

Híbrido com 2 a 3 dias presenciais no escritório de São Paulo, sendo um deles a quarta-feira;

Trabalho presencial nos clientes conforme necessidade.

Anbima é a sigla da Associação Brasileira das Entidades dos Mercados Financeiro e de Capitais. Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Consultor Financeiro - A partir de dados da carteira, realizar estímulos para os associados sobre soluções financeiras, verificando se fazem sentido para o momento de vida. Apoiar os associados em suas decisões sobre produtos e serviços financeiros, criando estratégias para a vida financeira e gerando impacto positivo nas comunidades onde a cooperativa está inserida;

  • Atividades transacionais - Controlar os níveis de endividamento da carteira e elaborar medidas de resolução da inadimplência, evitando custos e envolvimento judicial. Realizar cadastro e atualizações dos dados de associados;
  • Integrador de novos associados - Realizar a integração de novos associados, explicando sobre o Sicredi, tirando dúvidas, visando o engajamento do associado com os valores do cooperativismo;
  • Transações financeiras - Realizar (eventualmente e conforme demanda) transações financeiras de pagamentos, recebimentos e transferências.

Description

The WHS Site Manager plays an important role in helping our operation deliver to our customers. We are looking for motivated individuals who want to be the ones behind the Amazon smile.

The WHS Site Manager will be responsible for collaborating with the Site Operations team to execute company policies and ensure compliance with all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and kaizens, the WHS Site Manager will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risks in our processes, ensuring a safe and healthful working environment for our associates. A successful WHS Site Manager will demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the Operations Team and inspire change through comprehensive risk assessments and data analysis.

Key job responsibilities

  • Manage overall compliance with local requirements and authorities.
  • Provide advice and guidance on health and safety matters to all stakeholders within your designated area of responsibility.
  • Provide management information and statistics related to your area of responsibility.
  • Support business change through effective change management processes within a fast-paced environment.
  • Develop and maintain SOPs, ensuring Amazon’s requirements, guidelines, and policies are communicated and followed by partners.
  • Build strong working relationships with internal peers, and maintain and improve communication.
  • Develop plans for on-site emergencies, peak safety periods, cold/heat stress, special events, and other unique WHS situations.
  • Perform WHS data analysis and establish improvement plans.
  • Ensure accurate WHS record-keeping and reporting to support business initiatives.
  • Consult with legal for WHS regulation interpretations and investigations.
  • Develop and implement solutions to eliminate exposure to identified and potential risks and prevent injuries.
  • Understand local/regional regulations and company policies.
  • Audit workplace organization and associate behaviors to ensure training, auditing, and scoring methods are consistent and accurate.
  • Ensure site leadership and associates are trained and aware of their responsibilities under each policy.
  • Partner with corporate and regional WHS personnel to leverage global best practices.
  • Manage the Internal Commission of Accident Prevention (CIPA) at the site.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including pivot tables, charts, and graphics.
  • Experience in WHS or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations.
  • Advanced English skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in distribution center or manufacturing EHS with a mix of exempt and non-exempt employees at a site of at least 250 people.
  • Experience implementing lean principles and process improvements in operational environments.

Patria is, essentially, a long-lasting and resilient entrepreneurial Partnership, that continually assesses the environment and identifies trends. About Patria:

Patria is made of high performers like you. Behind every result we achieve as a team, there are talented people with unique set of skills: From an entrepreneurial spirit to high a performance mindset. From high-level expertise to a hands-on approach.

It is through these qualities that we have fostered trusting relationships with each of our clients. We proudly highlight our high returns to our investors coupled with our unwavering commitment to ethical values.

That’s why we have been known as the regional and sector specialist in alternative asset management with on-the-ground expertise everywhere we operate. Patria anticipates trends to create long-lasting impact for all our stakeholders for over 35 years. We envision to keep delivering consistent results to better serve our clients.

This position will be based in our Office in Brazil in a full in person work model.

Position Summary:

The digital workplace head is responsible for the strategy and management of digital workplace technologies and services, ensuring a seamless digital employee experience (DEX). This role covers all functions of the digital workplace, including the service desk management, budgeting, and IT asset management (hardware and software), enhancing digital dexterity, and driving positive business outcomes, while maintaining compliance with SOX and ITGC controls.

Main responsibilities:

  • Reporting to Infrastructure Head and partner with the CIO/CTO, human resources, facilities and other IT and business leaders to set the strategic direction of the digital workplace and DEX improvements.
  • Lead the digital workplace operations team focused on fulfilling (telephony included) end-user support and service requests, including the IT service desk, the VIP and desktop support, A/V support, Active Directory, IT services catalogue and IT asset management (hardware & software) inventory.
  • Manage the annual budget for operating and capital expenditures and govern digital workplace technology usage, standards, and licensing to align with IT and company objectives while optimizing costs and enforcing data policies.
  • Contract administration including management of service level for services in the scope including licensing expiration, renewal with different services providers and procurement team.
  • Lead the development, publication and maintenance of the corporate IT catalogue of product and services and its roadmap aligned with business requirements and IT leaders.
  • Provide IT leaders and business with a consolidated overview of IT Service Support KPIs (support tickets and service requests) submitted by the business area, ensuring adherence to SLAs (Service Level Agreements).
  • Champion the modernization of workforce technology and services to enable new ways of working and digital transformation, while demonstrating digital dexterity and fostering a culture of workforce digital dexterity by leading adoption, enablement, and influence to achieve digital business goals.
  • Partner with HR to understand employees’ current challenges, new roles, demographic changes, mobility, hybrid work and more, incorporating this knowledge into digital workplace planning, while utilizing organizational change management best practices to drive technology adoption.
  • Partner with corporate real estate/facilities to create a smart workplace that supports hybrid and remote workers as much as onsite workers.
  • Collaborate with colleagues in internal communications to communicate how digital workplace applications benefit employees through enablement campaigns and measurement of customer satisfaction and eNPS.
  • Work with IT security and risk management to ensure that digital workplace technologies comply with corporate policies and industry standards.
  • Responsible for SOX and ITGC controls within the digital workplace, including the polices creation or update ensuring flawless execution and developing action plans for improvements when necessary.


Main requirements:

  • (5+) years managing IT systems, processes and vendors.
  • (5+) years of leading digital workplace team and processes including external service desk services
  • English mandatory
  • Experience with vendor governance, KPI Management, including demonstrated success in conducting RFPs and vendor service transitions.
  • Proven financial management skills with operational budget tasks.
  • Awareness of ways to measure Digital Experience and satisfaction.
  • Working knowledge of IT frameworks such as ITIL, including key processes – knowledge, incident, change, service request and major-incident management.
  • Proven ability to manage rapidly changing business priorities, processes and technologies.
  • Experience managing a portfolio of digital workplace applications.

It isn’t just the performance that matters. We also care about the way we achieve our targets. We see our way of working as a differentiator, which contributes to retain the best team, to establish long-term relationships with clients, to expand to other countries, and to attract investors and partners who allow us to generate superior returns:
